description.value:
From D4C · Price: you must be pressed between two objects, such as a door and its frame, or under a flag.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 action while sandwiched: step into a parallel world and reappear next to a different pair of objects within 30 ft. Once per turn, your stand can also step through the other world: it Strides up to its Speed to a creature beside a pair of objects and Strikes it; the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} against that Strike.
  • 5: You can bring one willing adjacent creature. Surge: pull a creature caught between two objects into a parallel world for 1 round (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates). It returns at the start of your next turn. Surge: bring a parallel copy of a creature into this world; when it touches its original, both take @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}).
  • 9: A creature that critically fails its @Check[will|against:stand]{Will} save against the parallel world is lost there for 1 minute.
  • 13: Range becomes 120 ft.
  • 17: No change.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
